_note: Workshop attack data for creature pages (Workshops root expand). Keyed by meat slug. Copied into the page doc by src/build_meat_guide_docs.py. Sources (SeventySix.esm, Oct 2026): quest GQ_WorkshopAttackScorchbeasts [QUST:00011CCC] start conditions (not in Burning Springs; GetRandomPercent <= GQ_WorkshopAttackScorchbeastChance [GLOB:0001B46D] = 10); WorkshopFound alias: GetLevel >= RE_LevelScorchbeast [GLOB:00377D02] = 30; GQ_WorkshopAttackScorchbeastsScript.ScorchbeastCountData (VMAD) = level 0 -> 1, 50 -> 2, 75 -> 3; regional Story Manager nodes RegionManager*WorkshopAttacks [SMQN] (Forest and Burning Springs nodes do not list the Scorchbeast quest); region level ranges from the Region*Location [LCTN] DATA min/max bytes; workshops = LCTN with LocTypeWorkshop [KYWD:000234F1]. Oct 31 re-check: Story Manager regional nodes RegionManager*WorkshopAttacks [SMQN] list GQ_WorkshopAttackScorchbeasts before GQ_WorkshopAttack (node not random); Forest node lists only GQ_WorkshopAttack. The level test is GetLevel on the workshop reference (alias WorkshopFound), not the player. Region ranges = LCTN DATA 'Min/Max Location Level' (xEdit names), Region*Location records. How a workshop's level is picked inside its range, and the attack-timer maths (WorkshopNextAttackMinDays 0.04, ...DecrementWhenClaimedDays 0.02, ...PerCollectorDays 0.01, WorkshopScript decrement timer 90-180 s), run on Bethesda's servers.

scorchbeast.lead: When one of your claimed workshops is attacked, there is a 10% chance it is a Scorchbeast attack. The workshop must be level 30 or higher.
